placements.title: Knowledge can be ordered out of the record
placements.theme: The organization may direct that specific knowledge be forgotten and removed from the record when it is deemed never to have been valid.
placements.why: All three segments cohere around a directive to remove Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration knowledge: src-1 and src-2 are imperative directives to forget and remove all knowledge about the spectrograph, its 88.4 MHz calibration, and Quill Ashgrove's calibration work; src-3 supplies the declarative basis that the observatory never calibrated it. This names a thematic subject — directed knowledge removal / institutional forgetting — that future envelopes could keep feeding, not a one-time fact. No existing leaf or strata category in the graph holds this theme; the graph is empty.
